asked_by: Claude, before registering PR-037 - RETURN_SOURCE_REGISTER 3.1 ranked this source first because it is the cheapest to TEST, which is not the same as being answerable
conclusion: NO long-only book that is still a selection can separate a 2-point-a-year effect from zero here. Against the funds' own pool, two of eleven detects 4.56 points a year, three detects 3.18, four 2.32, five 2.16, and the registered TERCILE rule 2.86 - every one of them above the two points this literature claims. Only six of eleven gets under it, at 1.67, and six of eleven is 55% of the pool. The binding constraint is the CROSS-SECTION, not the book size: eleven candidates over 320 months is too thin to rank
selective_means: a book of five of eleven or fewer. Six of eleven is 55% of the pool
what_follows: PR-037 is NOT registered on this instrument. Spending a trial raises the deflated-Sharpe hurdle for every study after it, and a design that cannot detect its own claimed effect buys nothing with that. The source stays open in RETURN_SOURCE_REGISTER 3.1 with a stated trigger: a wider cross-section - industry-level funds, or the repaired stock universe
what_this_does_NOT_settle: whether sector momentum exists. This measures what this DESIGN could see, not what the market does, and a random ranking carries no sign. It also does not measure how the effect itself changes with book size - that would be reading the hypothesis before the registration
why_no_trial: the ranking is RANDOM, so this carries widths and no effect. Nothing here is a reading of the hypothesis and nothing is counted against the budget
